projection: fused norms after the same BF16 GEMM, with original MRoPE and Hadamard
keys: one independent logical slab, 32 B INT4 codes and 2 B BF16 scale per reserved key. Encode and append current projected K during each step.
query: INT8 per-head max-abs scaling, using the same quantizer as the reranking route
selection: FlashInfer ragged Top-2048 on the approximate full scores, or fixed vLLM persistent B4 / Ampere CuTe B16 for the selector sensitivity
baseline_scope: fastest correct SGLang, tuned dense and first-round lossless across old slot layouts, and their re-measured independent-slab counterparts
scope: complete layer Indexer from attention_input to Top-2048, excluding admission and including current key writes. Selection recall and output validity are retained for every cell.
